tracks.title: Hitam Dalam Asap
tracks.genre: Malay mak yong court ensemble song (Kelantan rebab, serunai and gong)
tracks.subject: A young Labu Sayong potter in Kuala Kangsar stays up all night feeding rice husk to the smoke-firing pit that turns the pots black, and hides a note in the base of the smallest pot for the city girl who bought it.
